positions.name: KnowledgeRemovalDirectives
positions.frame: what knowledge should be removed or forgotten from the organizational record?
positions.why: Both segments are directives from Xena ExpertGH to eliminate specific knowledge — the Quantum Widget Decision and the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration. They cohere under a single directional read: identifying which knowledge artifacts the organization should no longer retain. The two directives name different subjects but share the same act of removal, and the frame holds both without resolving whether the removals are related.
